title: Declaration
description: AI-parsed Source of Wealth declaration (Call 2 output).

sources.description: Structured wealth source rows extracted from the declaration text.

description.description: Brief description of this wealth source.

amount_sgd.description: Estimated or stated amount in SGD, or null if not specified.

start_year.description: Year this source began, or null if not specified.

end_year.description: Year this source ended, or null if ongoing or not specified.

jurisdiction.description: ISO country code or country name where this source arose, or null.

counterparty.description: Name of the counterparty (employer, buyer, etc.), or null.

evidence_sentence.description: Verbatim sentence from the declaration that supports this source.
